reviews.text: Friendly service, the dog always goes here wagging its tail. Good value for money.
Laura cuts excellent show trims and handles dogs really nicely❣️🐩 …
Absolutely top grooming salon - highly recommended ❤️ My very shy dog ​​was taken care of wonderfully 🙏 …
Little Armi turned out so pretty🩷 …

Our large poodle Carmen has often been to Laura's grooming salon for shows. Beautiful and refined shapes, which have been a pleasure to present in the rings with great success. Friendly and professional service and good home instructions and ingredients for coat care have been provided. Highly recommended!

I have been using all three of my poodles since 1993 at Laura's grooming salon.
Now the day after tomorrow I will be getting a large poodle puppy home and I have already booked a wash and trim from Laura for June.

Today I went to buy all kinds of pet supplies for my dog ​​and with these top experts, choosing them was easy: food, treats, chew bones, shampoo, grooming supplies, combs and combs, etc. etc.

It is really easy to do business there, when the help is always cheerful, positive and designed for the best of the dog.

Then the result of the trim is super beautiful 🥰🩷
My favorite women!
T. Inke
Great job and service 💪 …
Thanks for the feedback 😊 and have a nice summer! …
Credit trim shop for 10 years 🩷 …

Miso has been to Ronja's groomer a few times. The end result is always excellent even though the dog is a bit timid 🥰 big recommendation to the groomer and Ronja! Great customer service 😊 Many thanks! …

The best grooming salon in the world and such a lovely staff! You always feel welcome and the dogs love this place too 🥰 highly recommended!
Laura is a super skilled groomer and so dog-owner friendly 😇
Every time after a grooming visit, the whole team is so happy! …

Thank you Laura and Tiina for the professional and friendly service🐩♥️Grooming, food, all the supplies, etc. I really get what I need from Laura's grooming salon - thank you for treating dogs gently and listening to the dog😊🐶🐾Zima also jumped straight onto the grooming table today when he came to the salon✂️🐩🤍something has been done right♥️

Professional and knowledgeable service with all our hearts! I drove all the way from Oulu to go shopping and the next day my dog ​​was groomed by Laura extempore. The end result was absolutely stunning and this was a great experience for both the owner and the dog. Really friendly and flexible service in every way. This has become our trusted grooming salon and we will definitely come again, even though the distance is several hundred kilometers. I warmly recommend stopping by, I got a lot of informative information and new insights. Thank you so much❤️ You do your work with a big heart!
Dog-friendly handling and excellent breed knowledge of poodles. Accurate work and great customer service. High-quality and comprehensive product range ☺️

Absolutely wonderful place and such a warm-hearted staff! Things are really done on the dogs' terms❤️
Here I have found products for both professional and home use, and I have never been disappointed with the quality.
I have also learned the best grooming lessons here⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

After the trim, the small poodle mix was left REALLY untidy with long tufts of hair all over the body and ears! They asked me to come again for an additional charge, all other groomers do it in one go and I can do the job at home even though I'm inexperienced, but here some of the groomers are not suitable for this field and instead of doing the job in one go, you pay and you have to come to the place twice for an additional charge. Avoid this place, EXPENSIVE and arrogant attitude & uncertain outcome depending on the groomer.
For almost 14 years I have been able to enjoy Laura and Tiina's wonderful service ❤️
Thank you Keijo :)
Really good service. I received quick and comprehensive answers when I asked for more information about the products. I recommend
Essi the groomer took care of our really shy dog ​​professionally and on schedule ❤️ This will be our new regular place!
Top experts! Skilled groomers, thank you! 🐾❤🐾 …

A wonderful dog-friendly and professional place!
Rosalia, a little scared and agile toy dog, has received calm and very understanding treatment, which is what this type of young ADHD needs and can endure. The washes and trims have always been excellent and I have also received good advice.
We have been there 3 times now and will always go there.
A warm recommendation for Lauran Trimmaamo!

Thanks again,🐩❤️
Tv. Rosalia - now she sleeps well😍

Incredibly professional service! This groomer is a true poodle expert – from Toy to Standard Poodle. Every visit has exceeded my expectations. The groomers know the breed’s specific needs and make sure our dog looks well-groomed and gorgeous. Our dogs also have a great time. Plus, the grooming start and end times are consistent like a Swiss watch, making it easy to plan your schedule. If you want the best possible care for your poodle, I highly recommend this place!

Thank you so much for the warm and dog-oriented service ❤️ Boris, a standard poodle, has been going to Laura's grooming since he was a puppy for about a year, and we have been really satisfied. The dog loves to come to the grooming and has improved tremendously in handling and patience 🤩 …

Hi, I noticed that you are from the same family as Sandra, the previous feedback giver, and this feedback concerns the same dogs that she wrote her own feedback about, so please take a look at our response to her, thank you.

The grooming was done well, but the prices were completely unreasonable.
The pricing gave the impression of being greedy and unprofessional, as additional fees were added for every little setback. Horrible money-making, you seem to profit even from completely natural animal reactions.

I read the price list in advance, but I didn't think my dog ​​would be "difficult" on the roads, when he has always behaved well elsewhere. I know him to be the kindest dog in the world. In addition, my older, small dog, who peed out of fear, was charged a separate pee fee.

Thank you
Thank you Anna-Mari for your feedback!
Thank you :)
Despite all my prejudices, Jaska's grooming was a perfect success! Absolutely wonderful place and the handling of the timid dog was first class! Thank you very much! ❤️
Thanks Jake :)
